text: The ui-view Host UI Kit slice (yn1fk80a, at 2.1.19) records ListPageHeader and ListScrollArea as DEBT because 'one copy serves the ui-view and design-system lists', and CountBadge as DEBT because it 'shows the parameter count' in the ui-view list row. In the code the ui-view list (since 2.1.16, ui-view-list) already composes the catalog directly — EntityListHeader, EntityListLayout, LoadingState, EmptyState, Badge — and uses none of the three; only the design-system list still renders through ListPageHeader, ListScrollArea and CountBadge. The code was not regressed to match the debt wording: the three files now carry the DEBT header naming their catalog replacement, and the design-system list keeps using them (its slice, mq3b803z, records ListPageHeader and ListScrollArea as its debt). Assumed: the ui-view debt list should drop ListPageHeader, ListScrollArea and CountBadge (or say they are design-system-only), and the design-system slice should name CountBadge as its debt.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-1905 — ListPageHeader / ListScrollArea / CountBadge are debt of the design-system list only; the ui-view list keeps consuming the catalog directly
